$comment: Text pool for the Marriage/Relationship Problems prayer category.
requests: Pray for our marriage. We are in a hard season.
Starting counseling next week. Nervous but hopeful.
My wife and I have been married 18 years and lately we feel more like roommates than partners. Neither of us wants to give up. Pray for us to find our way back to each other.
We start marriage counseling on Tuesday. It took a lot for my husband to agree. Pray that we both go in with open hearts and that we keep showing up.
Trust was broken in our marriage this year. We are both choosing to stay and do the work. Pray for honesty, patience, and healing that lasts.
My husband moved out two weeks ago. We are separated for now, not divorced. Pray for wisdom for both of us and for our kids, who are confused and sad.
I lost one of my closest friends this spring over a misunderstanding that grew into something bigger. I miss her. Pray for the chance to make it right.
For my brother and his wife. They are going through a rough patch and he called me last night sounding hopeless. Pray they get good help and do not quit.
I have been dating someone for about a year and we are talking about marriage. Pray for clear wisdom about whether this is God's best for both of us.
Lord, help me be a better husband. I have been short-tempered and distracted, and my wife deserves more. Give me patience and a servant's heart.
A friendship I counted on for 20 years ended with hurtful words on both sides. I am grieving it more than I expected. Pray for forgiveness to take root in me.
Our marriage has been strained since the baby came. We are tired and snapping at each other. Pray for grace, sleep, and time to actually talk.
My coworker and her husband are separated and trying to decide what is next. She asked me to have our church pray. Pray for peace and good counsel for them both.

I never thought I would be writing this. My husband and I have hit the hardest season of our 25-year marriage. There are old hurts we never dealt with, and they have all come up at once. We have started seeing a Christian counselor, and some weeks are better than others. Pray that we would both be humble, that we would fight for our marriage and not against each other, and that God would rebuild what we cannot.

My girlfriend and I broke up last month after almost three years. It was mutual, and I know it was the right call, but it still hurts. We share a lot of the same friends and serve on the same team at church, so it is awkward. Pray for kindness between us, for healing for both of us, and for me to trust that God has good plans even when this season feels empty.
details: It has been a long, tiring season and we need God's help to see it through.
I am trying to own my part and not just point at the other side.
Some days feel hopeful and some days feel stuck. Today is somewhere in between.
Pray for honest words, soft hearts, and the humility to listen well.
We have a few trusted friends walking with us, and we are thankful for them.
I know healing takes time. Pray for patience while we wait.
"Love is patient and is kind" (1 Corinthians 13:4, WEB). I need that kind of love right now.
Thank you for praying. It means a lot to know we are not carrying this alone.
answers: Things are better than they were. Thank you for standing with us.
We are not there yet, but we are moving in the right direction.
God is at work. There is more peace now, and that is a gift.
Still waiting on a lot, but my heart is at peace. Thank you.
Praise God! This has turned a corner. Thank you for every prayer.
Some healing has come, slowly but surely. Please keep praying.
